messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment to prod completed by CI (release/2026-03-17-14). :white_check_mark:

jess_support: Heads up — p95/p99 lines on the 'prod - latency by route' panel are gone after that deploy. Customer on call reporting tail metrics missing. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/links/shot123

sam_sre: @jess_support can you paste the panel query or dashboard id? also which time range?

jess_support: dashboard id dash_87bc, panel 'latency_quantiles'. Time range is 1h. No error in console, just blank lines where p95/p99 usually are. p50/p90 still present.

alex_runtime: I saw a config flip in the deploy: metrics-collector image bumped and we switched default aggregation from 'percentile-agg:v2' -> 'percentile-agg:experimental'. Could be the culprit.

maria_ops: confirmed — the canary updated collector config to use the new rollup pipeline that emits only histogram summaries (sum/count/buckets) under a new metric name metrics.hist.summary.* not the old metrics.quantiles.* series. Dash panels reference series names that no longer exist.

jess_support: ok that explains missing series. any quick workaround for customers?

sam_sre: two options: 1) revert canary to prior collector image (fast but infra change), 2) update dashboard queries to use the summary-to-quantiles transform (we have a helper macro) until we backfill.

nate_ml: if we can toggle the panel to run the transform locally it should compute p95/p99 from histogram buckets. I can push a patch to the dashboard templates.

jess_support: would toggling to the transform be non-destructive? customer just needs the lines back for reporting.

nate_ml: non-destructive. query snippet: ```transform_histogram_to_quantiles(metric='metrics.hist.summary.route_latency', quantiles=[0.5,0.9,0.95,0.99])```

alex_runtime: we should also avoid relying on metric name strings in future. I'll open a follow-up to add aliasing in the ingestion layer so renames are transparent.

maria_ops: opened INC-2026-178: collector rollup naming caused dashboard break — assigned to eng-runtime + eng-ml. Reverting the canary now will restore old series in ~2 mins if we decide.

sam_sre: temporary patch: @nate_ml can you apply dashboard template patch to prod dash_87bc and verify? I'll stand by to revert deploy if needed.

nate_ml: applying patch to dashboard -> applied. Please refresh.

jess_support: refreshed and p95/p99 returned! lines a bit noisy since calc is client-side but customer is happy for now. :relieved:

alex_runtime: logging action items: 1) roll back canary or add aliasing (maria), 2) update dashboards to prefer histogram transform if needed (nate), 3) add alert that percentiles target missing series (sam).

maria_ops: starting rollback now, monitoring ingestion.

jess_support: thanks all. I'll reply to the customer and link INC-2026-178. Follow-up note: add a dashboard test in CI to assert p95/p99 series exist after deploy.

sam_sre: agree — test should run in preflight.
